column1: # Shape patches (ladder.adapter.shape.ShapePatches): edits of 1.20.4 classes that give a 1.21 mod mixin its point and keep
# 1.20.4 behaviour (the converter checks that on the bottom jar). Each class must be a target of ShapeTargetsMixin.
# PackEntry.mouseClicked ends with super.mouseClicked in 1.21 (libjf injects there); 1.20.4 returns false, which the super method returns
# OptionsScreen lays itself out in repositionElements in 1.21, at the end of init and on a resize (MidnightLib and Puzzle
# inject at its TAIL); 1.20.4's lays out in init and only inherits repositionElements (rebuilding the widgets)
